act_name: Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
heading: Short title, extent, commencement and application
title: Short title, extent, commencement and application
text:
1. Short title, extent, commencement and application.― (1) This Ordinance may be called the Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001.

(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.

(3) It shall come into force at once.

(4) It shall apply to properties belonging to the minority communities in Pakistan meant for their communal use.

act_name: Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
heading: Definition
title: Definition
text:
2. Definition.—In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,—
(a) “Commission” means the National Commission for Minorities.
(b) “Property” means places of worship, monasteries, seminaries, vicarages, dharamshalas, gaoshalas, burial places, community centers, social welfare, educational, health and recreational institutions meant for communal use of minority communities and includes side buildings, vacant places, lands, residential places or offices annexed to the said properties.

act_name: Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
heading: Ban on sale or transfer of minority communities properties
title: Ban on sale or transfer of minority communities properties
text:
3. Ban on sale or transfer of minority communities properties.— (1) No property of a minority community meant for its communal use shall be bought, sold or transferred by any person without NOC from the Federal Government :

Provided that nothing contained herein shall apply to a property bought, sold or transferred for a Housing Scheme, meant for a minority community, approved by a Provincial or Federal Government.

(2) The N.O.C. referred to in sub-section (1) may be given by the Federal Government on the recommendation of the National Commission for Minorities.

heading: Ordinance not to apply to evacuee trust properties
title: Ordinance not to apply to evacuee trust properties
text: 4. Ordinance not to apply to evacuee trust properties.___ Nothing in this Ordinance shall apply to the evacuee trust properties forming party of Trust Pool and vested in the Federal Government under the Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975 (XIII of 1975).

shall apply to the evacuee trust properties forming party of Trust Pool and vested in the Federal 
Government under the Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975 (XIII of 
1975).

act_name: Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Ordinance, 2001
heading: Punishment
title: Punishment
text: 5. Punishment.—Whoever buys, sells or transfers any property belonging to a minority community meant for its communal use in violation of section 3, shall be punishable with imprisonment of either description which may extend to seven years and shall also be liable to fine which shall not be less than one hundred thousand rupees and the sale or transfer transaction shall be of no legal effect.

text: 6. Removal of difficulties.___ If any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provision of this Ordinance, the Federal Government may make such order, not inconsistent with the provisions of this Ordinance, as may appear to be necessary for the purpose of removing the difficulty.
